description: This file defines an Angular standalone component 'LoginComponent' with a login form UI, event handlers for submitting login data and showing signup screen, and associated styling.

classes.name: LoginComponent
classes.description: An Angular component providing a login form with input fields for email and password, submit handling, and display of errors.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles the form submission, preventing default behavior, setting loading state, resetting errors, and emitting login data.

methods.name: showSignup
methods.description: Handles click event to trigger transition to signup screen by emitting showSignupScreen event.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^  @Output() login = new EventEmitter<{email: string, password: string}>();$/

fields.name: @Output() login = new EventEmitter<{email: string, password: string}>();
